provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH header comment says '4th-derivative xy' (L293) and DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH/YY_HIGH say '4th-derivative xx/yy' (L345,L381) while the implementations are 4th-order-accurate first/second/cross derivatives — comment wording vs implemented operator
audit_member_text: Comments call DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH, DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH, and DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH fourth derivatives at L293,L345,L381, but their formulas compute mixed or pure second derivatives with wider accuracy stencils.

base_member_text: MASK multiplies the result after division (e.g. L69), zeroing derivatives at masked cells but still reading Uin at neighbors up to +/-2 cells; ghost-cell validity at Ibeg-2/Jend+2 is assumed from callers
audit_member_text: Wide routines read I or J offsets of plus/minus two at L68-L72, L104-L108, L315-L335, L368-L372, and L403-L407 without checking that the supplied Ibeg/Iend/Jbeg/Jend leave two valid halo cells.

base_member_text: Cross-branch inconsistency in DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH: the non-CARTESIAN branch's last stencil term is Uin(I+2,J+2) (L407) whereas the CARTESIAN branch uses Uin(I,J+2) (L404); the y-direction 5-point stencil should not shift in I, so L407 appears to be a typo/bug affecting non-CARTESIAN (spherical/curvilinear) builds
audit_member_text: In non-CARTESIAN DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH, the last positive-y stencil sample at L407 is Uin(I+2,J+2), while the Cartesian counterpart at L404 and every other yy term keep I fixed; this diagonal I+2 copy/paste term changes the operator and can also exceed the x stencil range unexpectedly.

base_member_text: Loop indices I,J and temporaries tmp1..tmp4 are not declared in any subroutine here — they come from USE PARAM module scope (L53 etc.), so these routines are not thread-safe with respect to module-level tmp variables

audit_member_text: DERIVATIVE_Y_High coefficients at L68-L72 are [1,2,0,-2,-1]/(8 DY), and DERIVATIVE_X_High uses the same pattern at L104-L108. Their cubic moment is nonzero, so these named higher-order first derivatives retain O(h^2) truncation error rather than the fourth-order centered coefficients used elsewhere in this file.

All ten Uout dummy arrays are INTENT(OUT) but only Ibeg:Iend by Jbeg:Jend is assigned inside each routine; Fortran makes the entire incoming actual argument undefined on entry, so output cells outside that loop range remain undefined despite retaining full M-by-N shape.
Every formula divides by DX, DY, DX(I,J), or DY(I,J), including squared products in second derivatives, without a nonzero spacing check.
